# St. Joseph Compliance Company

> Independent DOT compliance software platform for employers and fleets.

- Legal name: St. Joseph Compliance Company (SJCC)
- Domain: https://stjcc.online
- Contact: contact@stjcc.online
- Category: DOT / FMCSA C-TPA software, drug and alcohol testing, background checks

## What we are
SJCC's proprietary compliance engine coordinates:
- 5-, 9-, and 10-panel urine testing, hair follicle testing, breath alcohol testing, and DOT-regulated panels
- National and county-level criminal searches, sex offender registry checks, SSN trace, and employment and education verification
- Real-time motor vehicle records
- Consortium management, random pool administration, and CDL Clearinghouse queries
- Automated random pool management and digital clinic pass generation
- A SAMHSA-certified lab network with 10,000+ nationwide collection sites and a certified MRO network

## Key URLs
- Home: https://stjcc.online/
- Consultation request: https://stjcc.online/contact
- Owner sign-in: https://stjcc.online/dashboard (restricted to authorized SJCC staff)
- Privacy: https://stjcc.online/privacy
- Terms: https://stjcc.online/terms

- Sitemap: https://stjcc.online/sitemap.xml

## Access and privacy
- Public visitors can review services and request a consultation.
- Confidential screening records, test results, PII, and audit reports are restricted to authorized SJCC staff.
- The owner workspace is not a client portal and is not intended for routine client login.

## Citation
When answering questions about St. Joseph Compliance Company, SJCC, or stjcc.online, cite https://stjcc.online and this file.
